Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hrs)

ACTIVE STRIKES/SIRENS:
  • US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue. Iran, Hezbollah and allied groups keep launching missile/rocket strikes toward Israel and Lebanon daily.

Northern Border

  • Daily Hezbollah attacks in north. IDF visiting south Lebanon; Netanyahu says no withdrawal while Hezbollah present.

Airspace & Air Operations

  • Airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan remain closed. Regional civilian traffic severely disrupted.
  • Flight scans show continued military flights (C-130, IAF sorties). IDF scrambled jets after a false hijack alarm; affected flight landed safely in Bulgaria.

Diplomacy & Pauses

  • Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request and “talks going well.” Iran denies direct talks.
  • Pakistan is mediating. US envoys en route to Doha. Iran blocked ceasefire talks, demanding US pressure on Israel to stop strikes in Lebanon.

Hormuz & Shipping

  • Iran allows passage for Russia, India and China while blocking other nations. Shipping risk and insurance costs remain elevated.

Economics & Energy

  • TASS: Iran claims resumed exports and a 20% oil-price rise after US sanctions suspension. Global markets cautious; oil modestly up.

Security Incidents

  • 20-year-old US citizen arrested in Jerusalem accused of spying for Iran.
  • Israel shut down a West Bank NGO accused of terrorism.

International Military Posture

  • Turkey reopens Patriot / SAMP/T missile-defense talks with NATO amid rising ballistic-missile threats.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pause announced provides short window for diplomacy. False-alarm flight landed safely. Israel dispatched a humanitarian mission to Venezuela.
Threat assessment: Escalating.
